about.title: About TownPulse
about.subtitle: A community directory for {{town}}, {{region}}.
about.missionBody: In small towns, a directory that is out of date is worse than no directory at all. Someone taps a disconnected number, travels to find a shop that closed last year, and stops trusting the site. TownPulse exists to make one thing true: if we show it, we can show you where it came from and when someone last checked it.
about.howWeVerifyIntro: “Verified” is a claim, so we treat it as one. A listing is only marked verified when all of the following have happened:
about.verifyStep1: A volunteer visits the place, or calls the number listed, and confirms it exists.
about.verifyStep2: They record who did the check and the date. This is shown on the listing.
about.verifyStep3: After 180 days the check expires and the badge changes back to “not yet verified” until someone looks again.
about.verifyStep4: If three residents report a listing as wrong it goes to a review queue. It is never silently hidden — wrongly hiding a working shop costs more than showing a stale one.
about.sourcesBody: Entries start from OpenStreetMap, the free public map anyone can edit, and from suggestions by residents. OpenStreetMap data is © OpenStreetMap contributors, used under the Open Database Licence (ODbL). We attribute it on every listing.
about.correctionsBody: Every listing has a “report wrong information” action and you do not need an account. If you run the place you can also claim the listing and correct the number and hours yourself.
about.privacyBody: No advertising, no third-party trackers, and no selling of data. See the privacy page for detail.

verification.closedBody: People have reported this place as closed. It may still be reachable.
verification.whatIsVerifiedBody: A named TownPulse volunteer has confirmed, in person or by phone, that this place exists at this address and that the phone number reaches them. We record who checked and on what date.
verification.whatIsNotVerifiedBody: The entry comes from a public map or from a resident. It has not been checked by us. Treat the details as a starting point and confirm by phone before you travel.
verification.whyWeShowItBody: Hiding an unchecked entry would remove a real place from the map. We show it, clearly labelled, so you can decide.
